plain_summary: This page details the tariffs for hiring various marine equipment and services. It lists rates for items like passenger gangways and mooring ropes on a 'per day of 24 hours or part thereof' basis, and rates for punt hire and forklifts (3 ton and 4 ton) on a 'per hour or part thereof' basis. For other services like Electric Power, Compressed Air, Any other equipment, and Divers Services, fees are quoted on application. A note clarifies that the owner of the vessel is responsible for damaged or destroyed ropes, mooring springs, or straps, and other equipment damaged beyond normal wear and tear may be repaired/replaced at the hirer's expense.
